description: Turn a ticker, name or address prefix into a token address. Verified tokens come first, and a token that only shares a verified token's ticker is flagged. Many tokens share tickers: hundreds of launches call themselves NVDA. Unverified results show liquidity, 24h volume and holders; get_token_market has more.

query.description: A ticker, name, or address prefix.

name: search_tokens
title: Find a token by ticker, name or address
